messages:
michelle: Quick sync — small public workshop next Wed 10am PT. Need a crisp runbook for registration -> zoom -> recording -> post-event followup. Goal: ASAP clips + hot leads in HubSpot within 2 hours.

michelle: Proposed plan: 1) single reg page w/ timezone picker + CTA variant A/B, 2) Zoom settings (cloud record, iso audio if possible), 3) live transcript + SRT export, 4) automated clip extraction + S3, 5) HubSpot lead enrichment + tagging, 6) replay email + 24h nurture. Thoughts?

devin: love it. can we add an "instant snippet" owner to pull 30s highlight for social within 30m? i'm happy to own the clip extraction pipeline.

sophia: tagging: use "event:workshop-2026-03-31" + lifecycle stage. also add "interest:inference" if they checked the demo checkbox.

ryan: Zoom notes: enable "Record to Cloud" and in Advanced settings check "Record separate audio file for each participant" (helps iso edits). enable "Auto-transcribe" so we get VTT. Set local backup on greenroom laptop too.

michelle: @ryan can you confirm OS-level disk space on greenroom laptop and test local recording? Also we need 2 backups: cloud + local.

ryan: will test today. quick test commands: 
```
# on greenroom laptop
df -h /mnt/recordings
ps aux | grep zoom
```
I'll post results.

emily: For registration page — keep fields: name, email, company, role, demo opt-in (checkbox). Add hidden utm params for paid channels. Confirmation page should have calendar link + 1-click add to google calendar.

michelle: Email timing: immediate confirmation -> 2hr reminder -> 15min reminder -> replay at 1h post-event + full edit at 24h. We want the instant clip out within 30-60m and replay link in 1h. Ops-bot, can you create a reminder checklist 3 days before and day-of?

ops-bot: Reminder created: 3 days before = "greenroom dry run"; day-of = "start cloud record, enable iso audio, verify captions". Will ping #marketing 08:30 PT day-of.

devin: Clip workflow notes: Zoom cloud -> VTT + M4A -> Lambda that pulls recording when status="completed" -> split by VTT timestamps for highlights -> transcode -> push to S3:/events/workshop-2026-03-31/clips/ -> webhook to socials queue. I'll stub a webhook:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.internal.redwood/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"clip_ready","path":"s3://.../clip.mp4","length":30}'
```
Need API key vault entry from security.

michelle: Good. @sophia can you draft the confirmation + 1hr replay email copy? Keep messaging benchmark-focused: "See how we cut inference cost by 3x in live demo" and include CTA to book a follow-up demo.

sophia: On it. I'll keep subject lines A/B: (A) "Recording + 30s highlight: How we cut inference cost 3x" (B) "Workshop replay + demo booking — 1hr edit ready"

ryan: Quick gotcha: Zoom sometimes delays cloud processing; add fallback to local upload to S3 if cloud status not completed in 45m. Devin can poll and if cloud incomplete then upload local file via scp.

devin: yep I'll add the fallback logic. also will emit an alert to #marketing if both cloud+local fail.

emily: HubSpot routing: map form fields -> contact props; set lead score + assign to SDR queue if demo opt-in checked. Add workflow to send an internal slack notify: "new hot lead: {name} {email} — demo opted" to #sales-inbound.

michelle: Ownership roundup: registration page + copy = sophia (+ emily on fields), zoom config & greenroom = ryan, clip pipeline = devin, hubspot routing = emily, overall ops + reminders = michelle. Anyone want to swap?

sophia: good. i'll also add a visible CTA on the confirmation page linking to a 30s teaser clip when it exists (placeholder until clip ready).

ryan: test checklist I'll post in thread after I run local record test. ETA 2pm today.

devin: i'll start lambda scaffold and mock webhook. need vault key name for socials hook: ?

sophia: @security please create vault entry name: events/workshop-2026-03-31/webhook-key.

michelle: final ask: can we aim for a dry run (greenroom + recording + local upload) this Friday? if yes we can schedule 30m slot.

rty (ops-bot): Dry run slot confirmed: Fri 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants.

michelle: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the runbook doc and drop the link here once I finish the confirmation + replay email drafts. :thumbsup:

sophia: draft done, dropping copy in #marketing-drafts in 15.

ryan: local test results: /mnt/recordings has 80GB free, zoom process looks normal. cloud record test completed — VTT delivered in 12m. all good.

devin: lambda scaffold up and a test webhook fired — clip_ready message received in #marketing. leaving followup tasks in GH issue.

michelle: awesome. leaving thread open for any last-minute items.
